body:
Hello,

Quick follow-up after the customer called and then replied by email. The caller introduced themselves as {{Name}} and confirmed that the email on file is {{Email}}. They repeated the callback number {{custom:phone}} slowly because the previous transcript dropped two digits. The conversation also included ordinary reference values like build 2026.05 and queue 000-00-0000; those are not labeled spans.

For finance, they asked whether the staged refund can still settle to {{custom:iban}}. For network tracing, the synthetic request record includes {{custom:ip_address}}. I am including extra wording here because real tickets rarely contain a clean one-line fact. They include apologies, small corrections, duplicate statements, and sentences that have no detection value. The final useful location cue is postal code {{custom:postal_code}} in the shipping section.

Regards,
Operations desk
notes: Page-tier EN conversational follow-up with repeated non-PII references.
